_comment: Copy this to ~/.pi/agent/auto-compact.json to customise the auto-compact-percent extension. Every key is optional: missing or invalid values fall back to the defaults shown here (a broken file never stops pi from starting). The file is rewritten by the /autocompact command. Env overrides: PI_AUTO_COMPACT_PERCENT, PI_CONTEXT_MEMORY.

_keys.percent: Compaction trigger as a percentage of the model context window (10-80). 38 sits just below the ~40% mark where long-context quality starts to degrade.
_keys.memory: Write a durable context memory (dense synthesis + full-fidelity raw archive) before each compaction, so the lossy step stays recoverable.
_keys.memoryMaxTokens: Token cap for the recallable synthesis (500-32000). It is injected back into the context when recalled, so its price matters as much as its completeness.
_keys.toolTokenCap: Maximum tokens a single tool result may inject into the context (200-32000); larger results are truncated.
_keys.keepRecent.auto: Keep pi's compaction.keepRecentTokens proportional to the current model window. NOTE: this WRITES into ~/.pi/agent/settings.json — there is no per-compaction override in pi's extension API, and the write happens only when the computed value changes.
_keys.keepRecent.ratio: Fraction of the context window to keep after compaction (0.02-0.5).
_keys.keepRecent.min_max: Bounds for the computed keepRecentTokens. The value never exceeds percent * window * 0.8, so a compaction can always bring the context back under the trigger (no compaction loop).
_keys.retention.enabled: Enable the archive retention sweep (runs on session_start).
_keys.retention.budgetMB: Total raw-archive budget in MB. Above it the oldest unprotected archives are rotated; 0 disables budget-driven rotation.
_keys.retention.rotateAfterDays: Rotate archives older than N days even while under budget; 0 disables age-driven rotation.
_keys.retention.deleteAfterDays: Delete ROTATED archives N days after they were rotated; 0 never deletes. Counted from the rotation, not from creation.
_keys.retention.protectProjectDays: Memories of the current project, and memories recalled within the last N days, are protected from rotation. The newest entry is never rotated.
_keys.retention.compress: true = gzip the raw archive on rotation (stays recoverable, ~85% smaller); false = drop the raw archive outright.

_where.memory: ~/.pi/agent/context-memory/<id>.memory.md (synthesis — never deleted) and <id>.archive.jsonl (raw archive — rotated to .gz, then pruned)
_where.ledger: ~/.pi/agent/context-memory/retention.json — usage ledger: recalls, last recall, project, bytes, status, rotatedAt
_where.index: ~/.pi/agent/context-memory/index.md — human-readable append-only log, one line per compaction
